predictive_services_discussion: Breezy westerly winds of 15–25 mph, with gusts of 25–45mph, are expected across parts of the northern and central Rockies. Winds across remaining parts of the Pacific Northwest and northern Great Basin are expected to be lighter than previous days, however locally dry and breezy winds continue across parts of the Sierra Front, southern Nevada and Utah, and much of Arizona amid RH of 5–25%. RH of 10–20% will persist across inland California and the northern Great Basin, while 12–25% RH and breezy southerly winds are expected from north Texas into Oklahoma, bringing high-risk significant fire potential to that area. Isolated to scattered mixed wet/dry thunderstorms are expected across eastern Nevada extending across Utah and southern Wyoming into the central Rockies, as well as Arizona and eastern New Mexico. Scattered thunderstorms, central and northern Plains. Isolated to scattered thunderstorms are expected across Florida and the northern Gulf Coast.
